'''Cularin Now''' was an organization that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Forg F'lopo]] recorded footage of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] attacking the patrons of a [[The Chasm|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and he planned to sell the recording to Cularin Now. However, the footage was confiscated by the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]].

==Behind the scenes==
Cularin Now was created by [[Matthew Domville]] and it received a brief mention in ''[[Forces of Cularin: Force Contention|Force Contention]]'', the second installment of the [[Forces of Cularin trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] campaign.
